senses.gloss:
[कुल् संस्त्याने अच्] 
__1 A hog, boar; [[Y. 3. 273]]; [[Śi. 14. 43]], 86. 
__2 A raft, boat. 
__3 The breast. 
__4 The haunch, hip, lap. 
__5 An embrace. 
__6 The planet Saturn. 
__7 An out-cast, one of a degraded tribe. 
__8 A barbarian. 
__9 N. of a tribe inhabiting the hills in Central India. 
-लम् 
__1 The weight of one Tola. 
__2 Black pepper. 
__3 A kind of berry. 
-Comp. 
-अञ्चः N. of the country of the Kaliṅgas. 
-पुच्छः a heron.

__1 A kind of village; [[Māna. 9. 486.]] 
__2 A kind of fort; [[Māna. 10. 41.]] 
__3 Some fruit or material employed in the foundation-pit.

कोलाहलः,
 
-लम् A loud and confused noise, an uproar; ततो हलहलाशब्दः पुनः कोलाहलोऽभवत् [[Rām.]]
